mapper.select: SELECT id,offering_id,chapter_id,title,description,estimated_minutes,type,status,is_required,due_at,late_until,allow_resubmit,max_attempts,max_score,content_version,current_ai_policy_id,published_at,created_by,created_at,updated_at FROM assignments WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.sql: SELECT a.id,a.offering_id,o.status AS offering_status,a.chapter_id,a.title,a.type,a.is_required,a.status AS publication_state,a.description,a.due_at, CASE WHEN f.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'REVIEWED' WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'SUBMITTED' WHEN w.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE 'NOT_STARTED' END AS assignment_state, s.id AS latest_submission_id,f.id AS published_feedback_id, CASE WHEN f.id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notifications n WHERE n.recipient_id=#{studentId} AND n.related_feedback_id=f.id AND n.is_read=0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unread_feedback FROM assignments a JOIN course_offerings o ON o.id=a.offering_id JOIN offering_members m ON m.offering_id=a.offering_id LEFT JOIN submissions s ON s.assignment_id=a.id AND s.student_id=#{studentId} AND s.is_current=1 LEFT JOIN feedback f ON f.submission_id=s.id AND f.status='published' LEFT JOIN workspaces w ON w.assignment_id=a.id AND w.student_id=#{studentId} WHERE m.user_id=#{studentId} AND m.role='student' AND m.status='active' AND a.status IN ('published','archived') AND a.offering_id=#{offeringId} AND o.term_id=#{termId}

t.id,t.offering_id,t.offering_status,t.chapter_id,t.title,t.type,t.is_required,t.publication_state,t.description,t.due_at,t.assignment_state, CASE WHEN t.assignment_state IN ('NOT_STARTED','IN_PROGRESS') AND t.due_at < #{now,typeHandler=com.learningplatform.common.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdue, t.latest_submission_id,t.published_feedback_id,t.unread_feedback
mapper.select: SELECT FROM () t WHERE t.id=#{assignmentId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS all_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.offering_status='active' AND t.publication_state='published' AND t.assignment_state IN ('NOT_STARTED','IN_PROGRESS') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS SIGNED) AS todo_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.assignment_state IN ('SUBMITTED','REVIEWED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS SIGNED) AS done_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.assignment_state IN ('NOT_STARTED','IN_PROGRESS') AND NOT (t.offering_status='active' AND t.publication_state='published') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS SIGNED) AS archived_incomplete_count FROM () t
SELECT assignment_id,requirement_index,requirement_text FROM assignment_requirements WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId} ORDER BY requirement_index
SELECT assignment_id,criterion_id,title,description,max_score FROM assignment_rubric_criteria WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId} ORDER BY criterion_id
SELECT knowledge_point_id FROM assignment_knowledge_points WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId} ORDER BY knowledge_point_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM submissions WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId} AND student_id=#{studentId}
SELECT id,offering_id,assignment_id,student_id,revision,active_file,created_at,updated_at FROM workspaces WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId} AND student_id=#{studentId}
SELECT workspace_id,file_path,content FROM workspace_files WHERE workspace_id=#{workspaceId} ORDER BY file_path
SELECT assignment_id,file_path,content FROM assignment_initial_files WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId} ORDER BY file_path
mapper.update: UPDATE workspaces SET revision=revision+1,active_file=#{activeFile},updated_at=#{now,typeHandler=com.learningplatform.common.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler} WHERE id=#{id} AND revision=#{baseRevision}
mapper.select: SELECT id,offering_id,assignment_id,workspace_id,student_id,attempt_no,workspace_revision,reflection,content_version,assignment_title_snapshot,max_score_snapshot,ai_policy_id,due_at_snapshot,submitted_at,is_late,is_current,created_at FROM submissions WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT id,offering_id,assignment_id,workspace_id,student_id,attempt_no,workspace_revision,reflection,content_version,assignment_title_snapshot,max_score_snapshot,ai_policy_id,due_at_snapshot,submitted_at,is_late,is_current,created_at FROM submissions WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId} AND student_id=#{studentId} AND workspace_revision=#{revision}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM submissions WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId} AND student_id=#{studentId}
SELECT submission_id,file_path,content FROM submission_files WHERE submission_id=#{submissionId} ORDER BY file_path
SELECT submission_id,requirement_index,requirement_text FROM submission_requirements_snapshot WHERE submission_id=#{submissionId} ORDER BY requirement_index
SELECT submission_id,criterion_id,title,description,max_score FROM submission_rubric_snapshot WHERE submission_id=#{submissionId} ORDER BY criterion_id
mapper.update: UPDATE submissions SET is_current=0 WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId} AND student_id=#{studentId} AND id!=#{currentSubmissionId}
mapper.select: SELECT status FROM chapters WHERE id=#{chapterId} AND offering_id=#{offeringId}
SELECT id,chapter_id FROM knowledge_points WHERE offering_id=#{offeringId} AND id IN #{kid}
SELECT user_id FROM offering_members WHERE offering_id=#{offeringId} AND role='student' AND status='active' ORDER BY user_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignments WHERE offering_id=#{offeringId} AND status=#{publicationState}
mapper.update: UPDATE assignments SET chapter_id=#{chapterId},title=#{title},description=#{description},estimated_minutes=#{estimatedMinutes},type=#{type},is_required=#{isRequired},due_at=#{dueAt,typeHandler=com.learningplatform.common.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler},late_until=#{lateUntil,typeHandler=com.learningplatform.common.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler},allow_resubmit=#{allowResubmit},max_attempts=#{maxAttempts},max_score=#{maxScore},updated_at=#{now,typeHandler=com.learningplatform.common.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='draft'

UPDATE assignments SET description=#{description},due_at=#{dueAt,typeHandler=com.learningplatform.common.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler},late_until=#{lateUntil,typeHandler=com.learningplatform.common.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler},updated_at=#{now,typeHandler=com.learningplatform.common.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='published'

UPDATE assignments SET status='published',content_version=content_version+1,published_at=#{now,typeHandler=com.learningplatform.common.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler},updated_at=#{now,typeHandler=com.learningplatform.common.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='draft'
UPDATE assignments SET status='archived',updated_at=#{now,typeHandler=com.learningplatform.common.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='published'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM submissions s WHERE s.assignment_id=#{assignmentId} AND s.is_current=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM feedback f WHERE f.submission_id=s.id AND f.status='published')

SELECT s.id,s.assignment_id,s.offering_id,s.attempt_no AS attempt_number,s.workspace_revision,s.submitted_at,s.is_late AS late,CASE WHEN s.is_current=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS superseded,'none' AS feedback_status, u.id AS student_id,u.username AS student_username,u.display_name AS student_display_name FROM submissions s JOIN users u ON u.id=s.student_id WHERE s.assignment_id=#{assignmentId} AND s.is_current=1 ORDER BY s.submitted_at DESC,s.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM submissions WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId} AND is_current=1
SELECT id,submission_id,assignment_id,offering_id,student_id,teacher_id,status,base_version,overall_comment,final_score,published_at,created_at,updated_at FROM feedback WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT id,submission_id,assignment_id,offering_id,student_id,teacher_id,status,base_version,overall_comment,final_score,published_at,created_at,updated_at FROM feedback WHERE submission_id=#{submissionId}
SELECT feedback_id,criterion_id,score,comment FROM feedback_rubric_scores WHERE feedback_id=#{feedbackId}
mapper.update: UPDATE feedback SET base_version=base_version+1,overall_comment=#{overallComment},final_score=#{finalScore},updated_at=#{now,typeHandler=com.learningplatform.common.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='draft' AND base_version=#{baseVersion}

UPDATE feedback SET status='published',published_at=#{now,typeHandler=com.learningplatform.common.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler},updated_at=#{now,typeHandler=com.learningplatform.common.mybatis.UtcInstantTypeHandler} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='draft'
mapper.select: SELECT id,recipient_id,type,title,content,related_offering_id,related_assignment_id,related_feedback_id,is_read,read_at,created_at FROM notifications WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT id,type,title,content,related_offering_id,related_assignment_id,related_feedback_id,is_read,read_at,created_at FROM notifications WHERE recipient_id=#{recipientId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE recipient_id=#{recipientId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE recipient_id=#{recipientId} AND is_read=0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) FROM course_offerings o JOIN offering_members m ON m.offering_id=o.id WHERE m.user_id=#{userId} AND m.role='student' AND m.status='active' AND o.status='active' AND o.term_id=#{termId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignments a JOIN course_offerings o ON o.id=a.offering_id JOIN offering_members m ON m.offering_id=a.offering_id LEFT JOIN submissions s ON s.assignment_id=a.id AND s.student_id=#{userId} AND s.is_current=1 WHERE m.user_id=#{userId} AND m.role='student' AND m.status='active' AND a.status='published' AND o.status='active' AND s.id IS NULL AND o.term_id=#{termId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE recipient_id=#{userId} AND is_read=0

SELECT a.id,a.offering_id,o.status AS offering_status,a.chapter_id,a.title,a.type,a.is_required, a.status AS publication_state,a.description,a.due_at, 'NOT_STARTED' AS assignment_state, CASE WHEN a.due_at < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdue, NULL AS latest_submission_id,NULL AS published_feedback_id,0 AS unread_feedback FROM assignments a JOIN course_offerings o ON o.id=a.offering_id JOIN offering_members m ON m.offering_id=a.offering_id WHERE m.user_id=#{userId} AND m.role='student' AND m.status='active' AND a.status='published' AND o.status='active' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM submissions s WHERE s.assignment_id=a.id AND s.student_id=#{userId} AND s.is_current=1) AND o.term_id=#{termId} ORDER BY COALESCE(a.due_at,'9999-12-31 23:59:59'),a.id LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id,a.offering_id,o.status AS offering_status,a.chapter_id,a.title,a.type,a.is_required, a.status AS publication_state,a.description,a.due_at, 'NOT_STARTED' AS assignment_state, CASE WHEN a.due_at < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdue, NULL AS latest_submission_id,NULL AS published_feedback_id,0 AS unread_feedback FROM assignments a JOIN course_offerings o ON o.id=a.offering_id JOIN offering_members m ON m.offering_id=a.offering_id WHERE m.user_id=#{userId} AND m.role='student' AND m.status='active' AND a.status='published' AND o.status='active' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM submissions s WHERE s.assignment_id=a.id AND s.student_id=#{userId} AND s.is_current=1) AND a.id != #{excludeId} AND o.term_id=#{termId} ORDER BY COALESCE(a.due_at,'9999-12-31 23:59:59'),a.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT f.id AS feedback_id,a.id AS assignment_id,a.title AS assignment_title, f.overall_comment,f.final_score,f.published_at FROM feedback f JOIN assignments a ON a.id=f.assignment_id WHERE f.student_id=#{userId} AND f.status='published' ORDER BY f.published_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT o.id AS offering_id,bc.name AS course_name,o.title AS offering_label, 0 AS completed_count,0 AS total_count,'chapter' AS progress_unit,0 AS percent FROM course_offerings o JOIN base_courses bc ON bc.id=o.course_id JOIN offering_members m ON m.offering_id=o.id WHERE m.user_id=#{userId} AND m.role='student' AND m.status='active' AND o.status='active' AND o.term_id=#{termId} ORDER BY m.last_studied_at DESC,o.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id,type,title,content,related_offering_id,related_assignment_id,related_feedback_id,is_read,read_at,created_at FROM notifications WHERE recipient_id=#{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapters c LEFT JOIN chapter_progress cp ON cp.chapter_id=c.id AND cp.student_id=#{studentId} WHERE c.offering_id=#{offeringId} AND c.status='published' AND c.is_required=1 AND cp.completed_at IS NOT NULL) AS completed_chapter_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapters c WHERE c.offering_id=#{offeringId} AND c.status='published' AND c.is_required=1) AS total_chapter_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.id) FROM assignments a JOIN submissions s ON s.assignment_id=a.id AND s.student_id=#{studentId} AND s.is_current=1 WHERE a.offering_id=#{offeringId} AND a.status='published' AND a.is_required=1 AND a.type='lab') AS completed_lab_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignments a WHERE a.offering_id=#{offeringId} AND a.status='published' AND a.is_required=1 AND a.type='lab') AS total_lab_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feedback f WHERE f.offering_id=#{offeringId} AND f.student_id=#{studentId} AND f.status='published') AS feedback_count

SELECT f.id AS feedback_id,a.id AS assignment_id,a.title AS assignment_title, f.overall_comment,f.final_score,f.published_at FROM feedback f JOIN assignments a ON a.id=f.assignment_id WHERE f.offering_id=#{offeringId} AND f.student_id=#{studentId} AND f.status='published' ORDER BY f.published_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM feedback WHERE offering_id=#{offeringId} AND student_id=#{studentId} AND status='published'
SELECT id,offering_id,author_id,target_student_id,title,content,created_at FROM notices WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT n.id,n.offering_id,n.author_id,u1.display_name AS author_name, n.target_student_id,u2.display_name AS target_student_name, n.title,n.content,n.created_at FROM notices n JOIN users u1 ON u1.id=n.author_id LEFT JOIN users u2 ON u2.id=n.target_student_id WHERE n.offering_id=#{offeringId} ORDER BY n.created_at DESC,n.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notices WHERE offering_id=#{offeringId}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM offering_members WHERE offering_id=#{offeringId} AND role='student' AND status='active') AS student_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignments WHERE offering_id=#{offeringId} AND status='published') AS active_assignment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM submissions s WHERE s.offering_id=#{offeringId} AND s.is_current=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM feedback f WHERE f.submission_id=s.id AND f.status='published')) AS pending_review_count, 0 AS pending_help_count

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) FROM submissions WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId} AND is_current=1) AS submitted_student_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM submissions s WHERE s.assignment_id=#{assignmentId} AND s.is_current=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM feedback f WHERE f.submission_id=s.id AND f.status='published')) AS pending_review_count, (SELECT AVG(final_score) FROM feedback WHERE assignment_id=#{assignmentId} AND status='published') AS avg_score
